label: NOTE: what this set covers, and what it cannot
why: V90SpectralShapingFilter.cpp entire: all five members of the class.  The constructor's nine stores are eight of one value and one of another, so what can be mutated there is WHICH word gets which value and how many get one at all.  The two run members share one recurrence, so what can be mutated there is every coefficient index, every sign, the BRACKETING -- addition is commutative and association is not -- and the shape of both loops.  Three things cannot be mutated into a caught failure and are absent.  The order of the constructor's nine stores, which no observer can distinguish.  The choice between four scalars and an array of four: identical layout, identical code.  And the ROUNDING of getMetric's return, because the object leaves 64 significand bits in st(0) where ours rounds to float, and a caller that captures a float cannot tell -- which is why the test captures a float and says so.  One more thing about the file's shape belongs here: reset() is written as a chained assignment where the constructor writes four statements, and that is not style.  It is what keeps every anchor over either of them unique in one source file (finding 1264).
